core_obligations: Projection formulas: the isomorphisms follow formally from the construction of Segre and Chern classes together with the earlier projection formula, including the composition rule; this is the only point where the proof refers to the literature, namely to the cited book for the analogous statement (proof lines 2495-2499).

Whitney isomorphism: after treating the degenerate ranks by hand, reduce by the splitting principles to the case of a line subbundle, display the successive rewriting of the pairing on a projective bundle, identify the last term and obtain the isomorphism by restriction along the divisor of a natural section; compatibility with admissible filtrations is formal (proof lines 2500-2520).

First Chern class and rank triviality: construct the isomorphism by induction on the rank using the displayed commutative square whose vertical maps come from the Whitney isomorphism and the multilinearity, and for rank triviality argue first for line bundles through the defining recurrence and then in general by the splitting principle, checking independence of the order (proof lines 2521-2540).

Restriction isomorphism and birational invariance: reduce to the case where the zero locus is either everything or empty, observe that the zero locus inherits the condition on relative dimension, and obtain the isomorphism by the displayed chain of isomorphisms on a projective bundle, the first and third steps using the projection formula, the second the Whitney isomorphism with rank triviality, and the last the projection formula again; birational invariance follows by writing the monomial in Segre classes and applying the corresponding proposition (proof lines 2541-2555).
proof_roadmap: Projection formulas through the earlier projection formula (proof lines 2495-2499).
Whitney isomorphism by the splitting principles (proof lines 2500-2520).
First Chern class and rank triviality (proof lines 2521-2540).
Restriction isomorphism and birational invariance (proof lines 2541-2555).
